name: Lightning Media
description: Slick media handling for Lightning. So cool you'll make the A/C jealous.

suggests.drupal/dropzonejs: Required for Lightning Media Bulk Upload, which provides an easy way to upload multiple media files at once.
suggests.drupal/entity_browser: Used by Lightning Media Image to improve image fields.
suggests.drupal/image_widget_crop: Adds cropping functionality to Lightning Media Image.
suggests.drupal/inline_entity_form: Allows entity browsers to create media items from file uploads and embed codes.
suggests.drupal/media_entity_instagram: Required for Lightning Media Instagram, which provides an Instagram media type.
suggests.drupal/media_entity_twitter: Required for Lightning Media Twitter, which provides a tweet media type.
suggests.drupal/slick_entityreference: Required for Lightning Media Slideshow, which provides a simple carousel media type.
suggests.enyo/dropzone: Provides a JavaScript library required by the DropzoneJS module.
suggests.vardot/blazy: Provides a JavaScript library required by the Slick module.
